**Subject: Executive Briefing proposal for Tamarack Instruments**

Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. Its AI use cases include a deployed customer service chatbot on the support portal, a visual inspection pilot on the German production line and AI sales forecasting planned for next year. An internal audit finding in June 2026 recorded no inventory of AI systems. Your stated objective is to have governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027. Customer data must stay in the EU, and the German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff. ISO/IEC 42001 work is expected to start next year, with no fixed start date.

**What the Briefing covers for Tamarack Instruments**

The session will map the EU AI Act and GDPR to each use case. These are expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. Examples include transparency expectations for the chatbot and whether the visual inspection system could fall into a higher risk category. United States obligations will appear only as a general landscape item. We will discuss an AI system inventory as a first control and sequence governance against the Q2 2027 objective. We will also explore how AI governance could align with the incumbent ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 9001 and internal audit frameworks.

The operating model draws on three sources:

* GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook)
* Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen)
* AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards), for board-layer material

It rests on three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent and Final Liability rests with the Human.

**Logistics and price**

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session for executive leadership and board-level attendees. The price is US$3,000. The proposed audience roles are General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. The Briefing does not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval.

**What you receive afterward**

You will receive a follow-up memo. It summarizes the decisions surfaced and readiness observations. It also sets out three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a further program option with a proposed timeline.

**Next step**

We would confirm the following at intake:

* whether the chatbot processes personal data and where it is hosted
* the function of the visual inspection system on the production line
* how the ISO frameworks are currently operated

A decision is expected by 15 December 2026. We would welcome your preferred session dates.

Kind regards,

AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
